images.prompt: Flat vector brand logo, 1993 pizza franchise identity. A bold red trapezoidal roof silhouette sits directly above a thick golden-yellow horizontal wordmark bar that runs the full width of the image and bleeds off both left and right edges, all over a flat red-and-white checkered vinyl-tablecloth pattern. CRITICAL: the checkered pattern must extend perfectly flat to all four corners and every edge of the square canvas with SQUARE 90-degree corners. Do NOT render the artwork as a rounded-corner card, app icon, tile, sticker, badge, plaque or button. No rounded corners, no white corners, no bevel, no glossy dome, no card, no frame, no rounded container, no drop shadow, no surrounding margin or border, no vignette. Full-bleed square: the background colour fills the entire canvas edge to edge. Crisp flat vector shapes, high saturation. The only text anywhere in the image is exactly: PIZZA HUTCH — bold condensed sans-serif in deep red on the yellow bar, spelled P-I-Z-Z-A H-U-T-C-H, correctly spelled. No other words, letters, numbers or symbols anywhere.

Cinematic wide establishing photograph of a 1990s dine-in pizza parlor interior. A red trapezoidal roof structure is visible through the plate-glass window, red-and-white checkered vinyl tablecloths on every table, stained-glass hanging lamps glowing low over each booth, a wood-grain arcade cabinet in the far corner, a chrome salad bar under a long acrylic sneeze guard, red vinyl booth seating, worn carpet. Completely empty, nobody present. Warm stained-glass lamp glow, saturated reds and ambers, deep nostalgic shadow, anamorphic wide lens, deadpan and still. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.
